full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2079 BS
Sixth Session
Meeting Number - 69
Federal
Daily Agenda
Thursday, Bhadra 19, 2082 BS
1:00 PM
Ministry-wise Question and Answer
Ministers concerned will answer oral questions related to the Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Health and Population, Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development, and Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation.
Tabled Message
2. Harka Raj Rai, Secretary of the House of Representatives, will table the bill along with the message received from the National Assembly regarding the "Federal Civil Service Bill, 2080 BS".
Management Work
3. The Honorable Speaker will present the proposal for decision on "Consideration of the Nepal Veterinary Council (First Amendment) Bill, 2082 BS".
The Honorable Minister for Women, Children and Senior Citizens, Nawal Kishore Sah Sudi, will present the proposal to "Send the Children Related (First Amendment) Bill, 2082 BS) to the relevant committee for clause-wise discussion".
4. The Honorable Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli will:
(a) Present the proposal to "Reconsider the Constitutional Council (Functions, Duties, Rights and Procedures) Related (First Amendment) Bill, 2079 BS, which has been returned with a message from the Honorable President".
(b) Present the proposal to "Pass the Constitutional Council (Functions, Duties, Rights and Procedures) Related (First Amendment) Bill, 2079 BS, which has been returned with a message from the Honorable President".


Pushpa Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
